record.name: Zabrak
record.description: Resolved and relentless, Zabrak embody endurance and self-mastery, their cranial horns and ritual markings signaling a life honed through trial.

innate_traits.name: Iron Will
innate_traits.narrative: Your species possesses an unshakable mental fortitude, honed through generations of hardship and trial. Your mind is as resilient as your body.

mechanics.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

innate_traits.name: Horned Fighter
innate_traits.narrative: Your cranial horns are not just ornamental; they are weapons honed through generations of combat training and personal discipline.

mechanics.description: You have advantage on checks and saves to resist being shoved or grappled.

innate_traits.name: Enduring Focus
innate_traits.narrative: Your species' legendary discipline allows you to maintain perfect focus even in the most chaotic situations, channeling your determination into precise strikes.

mechanics.name: Focused Strike
mechanics.description: Once per short rest, you can gain advantage on one weapon attack roll.

common_adornments: Small metallic rings or studs on horns
appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe a Zabrak character. Emphasize their intense gaze and the unique pattern of their horns, which reflect their personal history and achievements. Their facial tattoos should tell the story of their journey and accomplishments. Consider their natural resilience and the way they carry themselves with unshakable determination and focus.

class_synergies.narrative: Zabrak's natural resilience and Iron Will make them exceptional Guardians, able to endure any hardship to protect others and maintain their focus in the most challenging situations.
mechanical_benefits: Iron Will trait enhances resistance to mental control
High Constitution supports Guardian's defensive role
Horned Fighter provides natural weapons for close combat

class_synergies.narrative: Zabrak's natural toughness and Horned Fighter abilities make them formidable Soldiers, able to endure punishment and fight effectively in close quarters.
mechanical_benefits: Horned Fighter trait enhances unarmed combat
Iron Will supports mental resilience in combat
High Constitution allows for aggressive tactics

class_synergies.narrative: When a Zabrak's Iron Will is combined with Berserker rage, they become nearly unstoppable, maintaining focus even in the heat of battle.
mechanical_benefits: Iron Will trait prevents mental control during rage
Horned Fighter enhances unarmed combat damage
Natural durability supports reckless combat style

class_synergies.narrative: Zabrak's natural discipline and Horned Fighter abilities make them excellent Monks, combining physical and mental mastery.
mechanical_benefits: Iron Will supports mental discipline and focus
Horned Fighter provides natural weapons for martial arts

faction_synergies.narrative: Many Zabrak find kinship with Mandalorian culture, respecting their warrior traditions and code of honor while bringing their own unique resilience to the clan.
Zabrak often prefer to work independently or in small groups, following their own codes of honor and personal traditions.
Zabrak have served the Republic as elite soldiers and guardians, their natural resilience and discipline making them valuable protectors.

species_progression.base_description: Your species possesses an unshakable mental fortitude, honed through generations of hardship and trial. Your mind is as resilient as your body.

level_5.description: Your Iron Will has grown stronger. You can resist mental influences with even greater determination.

level_10.description: Your Iron Will has become legendary. You can project your mental strength to protect others.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can grant advantage on mental saving throws to allies within 30 feet for 1 minute

level_15.description: You have become a master of mental resilience. Your Iron Will can overcome any mental assault.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can automatically succeed on any mental saving throw

level_20.description: You are a living legend of mental fortitude. Your Iron Will transcends normal limitations.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can grant immunity to mental effects to yourself and allies for 1 minute

narrative_progression.level_5: Your Zabrak's Iron Will has grown stronger. Their mental resilience has deepened, allowing them to resist mental influences with even greater determination.
narrative_progression.level_10: Your Zabrak's Iron Will has become legendary. They can project their mental strength to protect others, their unshakable resolve inspiring allies and intimidating enemies.
narrative_progression.level_15: Your Zabrak has become a master of mental resilience. Their Iron Will can overcome any mental assault, their mind as unbreakable as their body.
narrative_progression.level_20: Your Zabrak is a living legend of mental fortitude. Their Iron Will transcends normal limitations, making them a beacon of unshakable resolve in the galaxy.

cultural_features.name: Iridonian Heritage
cultural_features.description: Your deep connection to Iridonian warrior traditions and the sacred art of personal discipline.
cultural_features.activation: When following Iridonian traditions or demonstrating personal discipline
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can draw upon the ancient warrior traditions of Iridonia, demonstrating the discipline and honor that defines your people.

cultural_features.name: Tattoos of Passage
cultural_features.description: Your facial tattoos tell the story of your personal journey and achievements, marking your passage through life's trials.
cultural_features.activation: When demonstrating personal achievements or facing challenges
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: Your tattoos serve as a visual testament to your journey, inspiring others and marking your personal growth and achievements.

cultural_features.name: Horned Warrior
cultural_features.description: Your cranial horns are symbols of your warrior heritage and personal strength.
cultural_features.activation: When engaging in combat or demonstrating physical prowess
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: Your horns serve as both weapons and symbols, marking you as a warrior of your people and demonstrating your physical and mental strength.

cultural_features.name: Enduring Spirit
cultural_features.description: Your species' legendary endurance and determination in the face of any challenge.
cultural_features.activation: When facing adversity or demonstrating resilience
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can inspire others with your legendary endurance, demonstrating that no challenge is too great for a Zabrak's determination.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Natural resilience and endurance in harsh or extreme environments
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: You thrive in harsh conditions, your species' evolutionary adaptation to Iridonia's challenging environment making you perfectly suited for extreme conditions.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced performance and focus in combat environments
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural combat instincts and Iron Will make you perfectly at home in combat zones, your focus and determination never wavering.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced mental resilience and focus in mentally challenging situations
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your Iron Will makes you perfectly suited for mentally challenging environments, your mental resilience allowing you to maintain focus where others would falter.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced performance in situations requiring discipline and self-control
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural discipline and Iron Will make you perfectly suited for situations requiring self-control and focus.

record.flavor_text: The Zabrak's horns are not merely a symbol of strength, but also a reminder of their people's unyielding resolve. Forged in the unforgiving environment of Iridonia, they have developed an unwavering commitment to self-discipline and the pursuit of honor.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: As a Zabrak, you embody the principles of Ryloth's warrior-monastic orders. Your character is a living embodiment of Iridonian resilience and martial prowess. They are driven by a strong sense of duty to their people and may struggle with adapting to unfamiliar environments or social norms.
narrative_hooks: A long-lost relative has been captured by the Hutt Cartel, forcing you to navigate the treacherous underworld to rescue them.
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Zabrak are known for their stoic demeanor, but beneath this façade lies a complex tapestry of emotions and relationships. They value loyalty above all else and will go to great lengths to protect those they care about.
common_motivations: Uncovering the truth behind a family tragedy

prompt_schema.base_prompt: a Zabrak warrior stands ready to face the battle ahead...
contextual_modifiers: standing in a proud stance, with one hand on the hilt of his lightsaber
kneeling in contemplative pose, surrounded by ancient scrolls and relics

resolution_paths.victory: The Zabrak warrior's honor is restored through their nemesis' defeat.
resolution_paths.redemption: The Zabrak warrior finds redemption by helping their nemesis overcome their past struggles.
resolution_paths.escape: The Zabrak warrior escapes their nemesis, but not without being forever changed by the experience.

tragic_flaw_overrides: Overreliance on brute strength, leading to neglect of strategic thinking
overrides.progression_path: The path of the Krayt: a ruthless pursuit of power and self-discipline

romance_progression.stage1: The Zabrak warrior is drawn to the romantic interest's strength and determination.
romance_progression.stage2: The Zabrak warrior begins to open up to the romantic interest, sharing their past struggles.
romance_progression.stage3: The Zabrak warrior and romantic interest work together to overcome a common challenge.
romance_progression.stage4: The Zabrak warrior and romantic interest share a deep emotional connection.
romance_progression.stage5: The Zabrak warrior and romantic interest seal their love with a ritual marking.

romance_events: A shared battle experience brings the Zabrak warrior and romantic interest closer together.
The Zabrak warrior helps the romantic interest overcome a personal struggle, strengthening their bond.
romance_modifiers: The Zabrak warrior's honor is boosted by their romantic relationship.
The romantic interest is more resilient in battle when accompanied by the Zabrak warrior.

courtship_styles: A series of trials to prove worthiness

ai_behavior.personality: A Zabrak companion is fiercely loyal, intelligent, and intensely focused on their mission. They have a no-nonsense attitude, but are fiercely protective of those they care about.
ai_behavior.motivations: To serve the greater good, to protect the innocent, and to uphold the honor of my people
ai_behavior.combat_behavior: A Zabrak will always prioritize taking down high-priority targets first, using their tactical expertise to maximize damage.
ai_behavior.social_behavior: A Zabrak is a natural leader, but also values input from allies and can be persuaded by persuasive arguments.

relationship_tracking.trust_levels: A Zabrak companion's trust in you will grow as they witness your strength, honor, and loyalty on the battlefield.
relationship_tracking.loyalty_triggers: When faced with an impossible choice between loyalty to their comrades or to a greater cause, a Zabrak will choose the path that aligns with their sense of duty and honor.

services.name: Warrior's Training
services.description: Teaches you how to channel your inner strength and resilience in combat.
